title: t5 (null-random-init): no behaviour to explain
label: null finding: model does not perform the behaviour
behavior: BOS + 5 tokens from 5 symbols; one symbol is read at the last position. The task was to recover the function and the heads/MLPs that implement it.
summary: The loaded model (1 layer, 2 heads, 1 MLP, d_model 29; local-full, full precision) does not reproduce the dataset's answers. Accuracy is 0.148 (n=128) and 0.191 (n=256) against a chance level of 0.20, and the mean logit difference between the correct and a wrong symbol is 0.002 and 0.006 with a standard deviation near 0.3. The dataset labels themselves follow a simple rule (a fixed map of the token at index 3), but that rule is a property of the labels, not of this model. The investigation was stopped after the baseline: no circuit is claimed and no verification was run.
pseudocode:
# No algorithm recovered: the model is at chance on the behaviour (E0002, E0003).
# Rule that fits the dataset LABELS only (E0001, 64/64, not implemented by this model):
#   out = {bo: lu, fe: ka, ka: fe, lu: bo, ri: ri}[tokens[3]]

claims.text: The model does not perform the bench behaviour: clean accuracy 0.148 on 128 inputs, mean logit diff 0.002 +/- 0.279 (local-full, full precision). The pre-registered prediction of >= 0.95 accuracy was refuted.
The null replicates on a fresh, larger sample: accuracy 0.191 on 256 inputs (chance 0.20), mean logit diff 0.006 +/- 0.319; the model also outputs PAD, which is never a valid answer.
Because the model is at chance, no attention head or MLP layer can be said to implement the behaviour; no circuit is claimed.

limitations: No verify_hypothesis run: with no behaviour there is nothing to verify, so the status is a null finding, not 'verified'.
The label rule (map of token at index 3) was checked by hand on 64 examples from E0001 only, and it describes the dataset labels, not this model.
No mechanism experiments were run; what this model does compute instead (if anything structured) was not investigated.
Accuracy 0.148 at n=128 is slightly below chance; consistent with sampling noise (0.191 at n=256), not tested further.
open_questions: The task statement says the answers are the model's own outputs, but the loaded checkpoint does not produce them. Is the checkpoint served under this investigation the intended one?
overall_status: unverified (no verification run) · null finding: model does not perform the behaviour

refuted_predictions.hypothesis: The model deterministically performs the bench behaviour: its top logit at the last position equals the dataset answer (the answers are its own outputs), so there is a behaviour to explain.

prediction.statement: Clean accuracy against the dataset answers is at least 95%.
